baseline_models.mechanism: The public saying, the sovereign source, the knowing witness, and the emphatic mission predicate form a testimonial act: the speakers place their disputed commission under the sender's knowledge.

activation_trace.role: Externalized speech makes the claim a public testimony rather than an unspoken conviction.
Sovereignty and ownership identify the authority whose knowledge guarantees the commission.
The thing's disclosure to a knower supplies the witness claim on which the speakers rely.
The carried saying and its bearers define the office asserted toward the audience.

changed_reading.before: They simply assert, with emphasis, that they are messengers.
changed_reading.after: They perform a formal commission-testimony: their sender-sovereign is invoked as the witness who knows them to be his message-bearers.

baseline_models.mechanism: The Lord as one who forms and completes, knowledge as a distinguishing mark, and the messenger as carrier combine into source authentication: the commissioning source can recognize the agents he has prepared and marked.

activation_trace.role: Formation, care, and completion cast the Lord as the source who prepared the emissaries.
A distinguishing, guiding mark turns knowing into recognition of source-bearing identity.
Carrier and carried message supply the identity that the source authenticates.

changed_reading.before: Our Lord's omniscience is invoked as a generic oath.
changed_reading.after: The claim resembles source authentication: the one who formed the carriers knows and identifies them as bearers of his message.

baseline_models.mechanism: The passive mission term and the directional phrase make a vector: another authority releases the speakers, while the audience is their assigned destination. Agency over origin remains above them; obligation to arrive points toward the hearers.

activation_trace.role: Sovereign control supplies the implied source of the passive dispatch.
Release and dispatch supply motion from a controlling source toward the stated audience.

changed_reading.before: Sent ones is a static title.
changed_reading.after: Sent ones names constrained, directional agents: released by a sovereign source and aimed specifically toward you.

context_deltas.mechanism: Two dispatched agents are denied, a third strengthens them, and the next statement limits their burden to manifest delivery. The plural mission therefore behaves as a reinforced delivery chain whose redundancy survives rejection.

activation_trace.role: The focus dispatch supplies the mission vector that context turns into a multi-agent chain.
Successive groups activate the movement from two dispatched agents to a reinforced plurality.
Explicit strengthening makes the third agent functional reinforcement rather than mere addition.
Delivering a message fixes the chain's task at transmission to its destination.
Meaning disclosed by speech or sign defines the required quality of that delivery.

structural_cues: 36:14 enumerates two, denial, strengthening by a third, then repeats the mission formula.
36:17 uses the restriction construction to confine responsibility to clear delivery.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: two are sent, denied, strengthened by a third, then assigned only clear delivery; reader arrow: plurality functions as resilient transmission redundancy; live alternative: the numbers may be narrative sequence without a general delivery architecture.

changed_reading.before: We are sent is a plural credential claim.
changed_reading.after: We are sent identifies a reinforced, rejection-resistant delivery chain whose success is clear transmission, not forced acceptance.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus speakers' our Lord is followed by a hearer who trusts your Lord, asks to be heard, and then speaks of my Lord. The possessive shifts make lordship traversable across speaker and audience positions rather than a closed party label.

activation_trace.role: Our sovereign Lord supplies the relational title whose pronoun later changes.
Heart-settling assent supplies the hearer's transition from receiving speech to trusting its Lord.
Your Lord transfers the same sovereign relation into the audience's grammatical position.
Hearing as understanding and compliance supplies the social hinge for that transfer.
My Lord's restorative care completes the movement as personally experienced lordship.

structural_cues: The sequence shifts possessives from our Lord in 36:16 to your Lord in 36:25 and my Lord in 36:27.
The imperative hear me sits at the point where an audience member voices the messengers' relation for himself.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: the Lord-title moves through our, your, and my while a hearer declares trust; reader arrow: the pronouns trace adoption across the speech relation; live alternative: they may only reflect different speakers with no designed progression.

changed_reading.before: Our Lord sounds like the envoys' private or factional possession.
changed_reading.after: Our Lord opens a bridge the hearer can cross: through understanding, the audience's Lord becomes personally confessed as my Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus knowledge branch already permits a distinguishing mark; the surah then records surviving traces exhaustively and repeatedly presents visible signs from the Lord. Knowing is thus surrounded by an evidentiary field, not left as an inaccessible private assertion.

activation_trace.role: A mark that distinguishes and guides supplies the focus-side bridge from knowledge to evidence.
A remaining mark that indicates what occurred gives knowledge a durable evidentiary residue.
Exhaustive counting makes the preservation of those traces comprehensive rather than selective.
Visible signs supply public markers that can be encountered, even when recipients turn away.
Attribution of the signs to their Lord links the evidentiary markers back to the focus knower-source.

structural_cues: 36:12 coordinates writing, prior deeds, surviving traces, exhaustive enumeration, and a clear register.
36:46 repeats sign language and explicitly attributes the signs to their Lord while describing deliberate turning away.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: knowledge can be a distinguishing mark, traces are exhaustively preserved, and visible signs come from the Lord; reader arrow: the Lord's knowing generates an inspectable evidentiary field; live alternative: divine knowledge may remain immediate while traces and signs serve separate functions.

changed_reading.before: Our Lord knows appeals to a fact the audience cannot inspect.
changed_reading.after: Our Lord knows places the commission within a world where knowledge leaves countable traces and Lord-given signs, shifting the dispute from absent evidence to refused evidence.

context_deltas.mechanism: At awakening, the formerly resistant speakers identify fulfilled promise and confess that the messengers spoke truth. The focus appeal to the Lord's present knowledge acquires a delayed public verdict at the very event the message announced.

activation_trace.role: The focus message-bearers supply the claim whose truth awaits recognition.
Rousing the still from rest supplies the event at which the prior claim becomes publicly testable.
A promise held open in speech supplies the earlier message's future-facing content.
Realization in act supplies the later criterion by which messenger-speech is acknowledged as true.
The audience's naming of the message-bearers closes the delayed verification loop.

structural_cues: 36:52 puts the recognition in the mouths of those newly raised and joins promise with the truth of the messengers.
The perfect verbs present the promised event and messenger truth as realized facts.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: awakening produces an acknowledgment that the promised event occurred and the messengers were truthful; reader arrow: this is the public horizon of the focus claim's verification; live alternative: the plural messengers may denote the whole prophetic class rather than the town's envoys specifically.

changed_reading.before: The speakers answer present denial with an unverifiable appeal to divine knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Their appeal is temporally escrowed: what the Lord knows now becomes the deniers' own public verdict when the promised awakening occurs.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah later seals ordinary mouths, transfers intelligible speech to hands, and assigns knowledgeable testimony to feet. This reconfigures the focus contest of sayings: truth under the Lord's knowledge is not finally hostage to whichever mouth controls the exchange.

activation_trace.role: The envoys' audible utterance supplies the initial mouth-based testimony.
Knowledge beyond the speakers supplies the appeal that can survive a contested verbal exchange.
A securing seal disables the ordinary channel through which verbal control is exercised.
Intelligible speech connecting speakers migrates to the hands as replacement testimony.
Statement grounded in knowledge turns the feet into evidentiary witnesses.

structural_cues: 36:65 changes the grammatical subjects of speaking and witnessing from mouths to hands and feet.
The sealing precedes the replacement testimony, making the channel reversal causal in the scene.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: mouths are disabled while bodily members speak and testify; reader arrow: the focus appeal anticipates a truth regime that bypasses disputed mouths; live alternative: the later scene may concern only final accounting, not the credibility dispute in 36:16.

changed_reading.before: They counter one spoken accusation with another spoken assertion.
changed_reading.after: They appeal beyond the mouth-to-mouth contest to a knower able to disclose truth through channels the disputants cannot manage.

context_deltas.mechanism: Near the close, hostile saying is placed directly beside divine knowing of what is concealed and publicized. This exact speech/knowledge opposition makes the focus formula a stabilizer under rejection: adversarial talk cannot alter the knower's grasp of either outer claim or inner motive.

activation_trace.role: The envoys' public utterance supplies one side of the focus speech conflict.
Disclosure to the Lord supplies the invariant epistemic ground beneath that conflict.
Their externalized saying supplies the hostile discourse that is not to govern the recipient's state.
Divine knowing is stated as the direct counterweight to adversarial speech.
Concealment in the interior extends knowledge behind the opponents' spoken surface.
Public manifestation completes the inner/outer scope of what is known.

structural_cues: 36:76 gives hostile saying as the object of grief and immediately answers it with first-person divine knowing.
The paired relative clauses cover both what opponents conceal and what they announce.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: their saying is answered by knowledge of concealed and announced material; reader arrow: the closing opposition explicates the defensive force of our Lord knows in 36:16; live alternative: 36:76 directly consoles a different addressee and need not gloss the town envoys.

changed_reading.before: Our Lord knows merely intensifies the speakers' denial of lying.
changed_reading.after: Our Lord knows contains hostile discourse within a wider inner-and-outer knowledge, preventing opponents' saying from becoming the measure of mission truth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus has envoys speaking about their Lord; later a saying comes from a merciful Lord, and finally divine command-speech coincides with occurrence. The sequence differentiates relay speech from source speech: the messengers carry authority whose effective origin remains with the Lord.

activation_trace.role: The envoys' utterance supplies the human relay side of the speech hierarchy.
Carried saying and carrier supply the relay relation linking human speech to its source.
Safety and freedom from harm supply the content delivered by source speech.
An explicit utterance now originates from the Lord rather than from his envoys.
The sovereign invoked in the focus becomes the stated source of the later saying.
Binding command supplies the authoritative force attached to divine saying.
The Lord's utterance supplies source speech at the point of commanded realization.
Occurrence in time supplies the realized outcome that distinguishes source command from relay testimony.

structural_cues: The speaker-source of saying shifts from envoys in 36:16 to a merciful Lord in 36:58.
36:82 places saying between divine command and immediate occurrence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet: envoy speech, Lord-origin speech, and command followed by occurrence occupy distinct scenes; reader arrow: they form a source-relay hierarchy; live alternative: the scenes may illustrate unrelated speech functions without a designed arc.

changed_reading.before: The envoys' statement stands as an autonomous defense of their own credibility.
changed_reading.after: Their statement is relay speech: it carries a source authority whose own saying later reaches recipients and whose command, unlike theirs, effects the outcome.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it maps a human mission onto the surah's celestial motion and activates the form-distant agent or messenger branch of ج ر ي. It remains valid because مُرْسَلُونَ and إِلَيْكُمْ already anchor dispatch and destination, while the context supplies a running agent, fixed station, measured governance, and the same knowing source. Downstream prose should present it only as a spatial analogy for directed commission, not as an identification of the envoys with celestial bodies.

activation_trace.role: Dispatch and release anchor the envoys as moving from a source toward an assigned destination.
The running agent or messenger image activates mission as an assigned course rather than only an office.
Fixity and settlement supply a determined endpoint for the course.
Governance by measured planning supplies the directional ordering behind the mission.
The knowing attribute reconnects the measured course to the knower invoked in the focus.

changed_reading.before: We are sent to you names human accreditation and destination.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the envoys are directed course-runners within a measured order: their toward-you mission resembles an assigned trajectory known and governed by its source.

strongest_changes: The local two-plus-third sequence turns plural dispatch into a reinforced delivery chain whose bounded task is manifest transmission.
Traces, exhaustive enumeration, and Lord-given signs move our Lord knows from private guarantee toward an evidentiary field that recipients can still refuse.
Resurrection acknowledgment and the hidden/revealed knowledge formula extend the focus claim from present counter-speech to delayed public vindication.
summary.what_was_special: Across the whole surah, the focus roots repeatedly change speaker, channel, and temporal position: envoy saying becomes Lord-origin saying, claimed mission becomes confessed truth, and knowledge moves from invoked witness to traces, bodily testimony, and disclosure of inner and outer speech.
remaining_uncertainties: The recognition in 36:52 may concern messengers collectively rather than these town envoys alone.
The our-your-my Lord sequence may be ordinary speaker deixis rather than a designed adoption path.
The measured-trajectory reading depends on a form-distant ج ر ي branch and should remain exploratory.
